name: Tougi Shiro
source: Shiro is a fourth-year student who gives off a delicate image, and is very shy. She was introduced to the student council by her older brother [url=/c1199]Seiichirou[/url] who was already on the council, and it was decided that Shiro would become the treasurer. However, she is often missing from student council meetings after school. Shiro joins an organization named "Laurel Ring" in order to support a chapel, and she cherishes a white pet rabbit named Yukimaru (雪丸) at the chapel.
